problem: If $A={1,2,3,4,5,6,7}$, which collection of subsets of $A$ is a partition of $A?$

feedback.problem: If $G={10,15,20,25,30,35},$ which collection of subsets of $G$ is a partition of $G?$
feedback.worked_solution:
A partition of a set $G$ is a collection of non-empty subsets of $G$ where every element of $G$ is contained in *exactly* one subset. 

Of the given collections, only ${{10,15,35},{20},{25,30}}$ is a partition.

The rest of the collections are not partitions:

- ${∅,{10,15,35},{20},{25,30}}$ is not a partition because the subset $∅$ is empty.

- ${{10,15,25,35},{20,25,30}}$ is not a partition because the element $25$ appears in two subsets.

- ${{10,15,20,30},{20,30},{25,35,30}}$ is not a partition because the elements $20$ and $30$ appear in multiple subsets.

- ${{15,20,25,30,35}}$ is not a partition because the element $10\in G$ does not appear in any subset.
